note: The Consumer Defence Code, article 43, paragraph 1, bars a consumer register from holding negative information for more than five years, as the Ceará Public Prosecutor's Office quotes it (the Planalto's own text gave no reply here). No source states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: Ministério Público do Ceará, Prazo SPC/Serasa: você sabia?
sources.said: CDC, Art. 43 § 1º - Os cadastros e dados de consumidores devem ser objetivos, claros, ... referentes a período superior a 5 (cinco anos).
